_note_tight: KULEMA CHAMUKANDA WUNU: the Board Chairperson signature spilled onto a page of its own; the section's paragraph gaps tightened so it stays with its text.
_note_dropBreaks: Every sub-topic opened a fresh page, leaving near-empty pages where one spilled a few lines over: those breaks dropped (numbers from _breaks.json, picked by measuring pages under 45% full).
_note_outcomes: Specific-outcome codes follow the book's own short form (1.2.1, 3.1.1 ...): the first (5.1.1.1) brought into line, the 5.7.5 outcome's repeated 7.4.1 made 7.5.1, a stray colon after 7.4.1 dropped, missing spaces after 3.2.1 and 6.1.1 added; the 7.1.1 outcome (a heading with its text on the next line) set run-in like the rest.
